name: ASSEMBLY
description: A participatory identity for an urban arts collective. Four fitted pieces, energetic citron, and type that behaves like signage turn many voices into one strong system.
heading: bebas
rules: The four fitted pieces must remain distinguishable.
Use sign-like large capitals and keep event details in consistent blocks.
Citron surfaces carry workshop-colored text for accessible contrast.

system.concept: Fitted graphic modules, large civic type, constructive street-poster layouts, and a high-visibility citron palette. Many voices combine into one deliberately public system.
headline: Bring your part.
Build something together.
features: A public practice with room for many kinds of contribution.
Useful graphic expression that brings people toward a shared goal.
A collective that values participation as much as the finished work.
system.layoutNote: Citron poster hero with condensed civic headings, fitted-module artwork, 2px section lines, and square controls. Event details use practical date / title / place columns.
